rows.query: How many days do I have to send something back?
rows.answer:
You have 30 days from the original purchase date to start a standard return. The item must be unworn, unwashed and unaltered, with the original tags attached and in sellable condition. You'll also need your order number or proof of purchase. Eligible returns get a full refund to the original form of payment.

Two other timeframes may apply:
- **Instant Exchange:** If you're offered this on the Returns Portal, drop your return off at UPS within 21 days. If you don't, your card will be charged the full price of the replacement item.
- **Defective or damaged items:** Contact customerservice@aloyoga.com or call (855) 793-3100 within 30 days of receiving the item. Alo covers return shipping for these. Reports made after 30 days are reviewed case by case and aren't guaranteed to be accepted.

I don't have your order details in front of me, so I can't give you your exact deadline. Count 30 days from your purchase date. If you tell me the date, I can help you work it out.
